_description: Contract schema for Rise FC schema operator validator result sets. Defines the required shape of external validator output records from Prompt 04. This is a contract definition only — not a real run artifact.

runId.description: Run identifier this validator result set belongs to.

validatorRunDate.description: ISO 8601 date the external validators were run.

schemaProfile.description: Active schema profile at time of validation.

draftVersion.description: Identifier of the draft version submitted to validators.

overallValidatorDecision.description: Aggregated validator decision across all tools.

detectedItemTypes.description: Schema item types detected by the Google Rich Results Test.

errors.description: Errors reported by the Google Rich Results Test.

warnings.description: Warnings reported by the Google Rich Results Test.

evidenceLink.description: URL or screenshot reference for the validator result. Optional.

errors.description: Errors reported by the Schema.org Validator.

warnings.description: Warnings reported by the Schema.org Validator.

evidenceLink.description: URL or screenshot reference for the validator result. Optional.

errors.description: Errors reported by Screaming Frog, if available.

warnings.description: Warnings reported by Screaming Frog, if available.

evidenceLink.description: Export file reference for the Screaming Frog result. Optional.

heldFieldDetectedInValidatorOutput.description: Whether any held field was detected in live validator output. Must be false for a compliant result.

blockedModuleDetectedInValidatorOutput.description: Whether any blocked module type was detected in live validator output. Must be false.

detectedTypesMatchAllowedModules.description: Whether all detected item types are in the allowed modules list for the active schema profile.
